meaningEvidence: Original downloaded soundtrack and full local Albanian ASR reviewed, 0–129.56 seconds; metadata duration 130.14 seconds.
Original poster independently viewed: ochre facade, shuttered windows, small portrait above entry, address117 to the right, creator inset and Trevi graphic.

ASR provides the visit behind Trevi, entering to ask about surviving traces and being referred to the portrait, diplomatic-support context, and closing concern that Albanian history is not sufficiently told from an Albanian perspective.
limitations: ASR contains numerical/name errors; no uncertain sentence is quoted verbatim.
Exact stay dates/nights at this palace, troop totals, aid totals, hotel rates and the accommodation conversion year are omitted.
The current portrait is not asserted to be an unchanged fifteenth-century original; palace construction/ownership by Skanderbeg is not asserted.
The conversation inside is the creator’s reported experience; it is not a complete inventory of the building’s historic contents.
Palace history is the current operator’s account; diplomatic context is supported by scholarly publication of contemporary testimony, not an original manuscript inspected here.
Exact filming date is unknown; upload date is not substituted for it.
